test_results.observation: Fresh CLI ingestion returned created with activation_changed true and two chunks.
Exact replay returned reused with activation_changed false and identical resource IDs.
Changed normalized content creates a new Document Version, Chunk Set and Embedding Set while preserving Document identity.
Equal content under a different source key creates a different Document.
Raw-size, normalized-token and chunk-count limits fail before provider invocation and persistence.
1535-dimensional provider output returns EMBEDDING_DIMENSION_MISMATCH before commit.
Late stale commit returns DOCUMENT_CONCURRENTLY_UPDATED; retry persists cleanly and active pointer remains revision-protected.
Remediation run created and activated a fresh CLI derivation chain.
Exact replay reused all IDs and did not change activation.
Changed content creates a new immutable derivation chain for the same logical Document.
Different source keys remain separate Documents.
All synchronous limits fail before provider invocation.
Revision CAS rejects stale commits and retry persists without partial state.
